top.line: A roadmap for RiskMandate, and a foundation for the Agent Behaviour Policy.
top.para: OWASP said no to the Agent Behaviour Policy as a project, so it gets a foundation: governance outside RiskMandate, today mostly The Cyber Boardroom. The roadmap: policies, understand, contain, manage, accelerate, then insurance. We are in the first stage, creating the policies and the flows with our first customers at customers.riskmandate.ai.

in-short.line: Seven points: OWASP, a foundation, five stages, where we are, open.
in-short.para: OWASP said no, so the policy gets a foundation, governed outside RiskMandate. The roadmap has five stages, then insurance. We are in the first, creating the policies and flows with our first customers, whose programme is live at customers.riskmandate.ai. Later stages start as needed. Everything stays open, CC BY 4.0 and Apache 2.0.

foundation.line: A foundation, now that OWASP has said no.
foundation.para: On 8 October the founders decided to propose the policy to OWASP, because a description of what an agent can do should not belong to the company that sells it. OWASP said no, so a foundation will govern it outside RiskMandate, today mostly The Cyber Boardroom. RiskMandate still sells services on the policy; the policy itself is shared.

roadmap.para: Policies: write each agent's grant, mandate, delta and barrier. Understand: see what agents actually do against it. Contain: move rules out of the agent's reach. Manage: a holder per rule, a decision per gap, a test pack per change. Accelerate: give agents more, safely. Insurance: evidence of containment, the top of RiskMandate's published ladder.

now.line: Where we are: the policies, with our first customers.
now.para: Stage one is sorting out the policies and their flows, through the first customers' site at customers.riskmandate.ai. Its seven milestone steps follow the first stage, from credit and one named agent to the usage moment. At v0.1.1 it counts three customers, two started, 3 of 21 steps done, no first policy yet and no credit used.

later.line: The later stages, as they are needed.
later.para: The stages after the first are not a schedule. Each starts when customers need it, as users grow and the offering matures. Some pieces already exist in what we have published, from hooks and test packs to the insurance pages; the roadmap adds the order and the name of the plan.

limits.para: The foundation is a decision, not yet an entity. OWASP has endorsed nothing; it declined the project. The stage meanings are a first reading, and only the first stage is under way. The roadmap has no dates. The counts are the customer site's own, read on 20 October 2026.

sources.para: A voice memo of 20 October 2026; RiskMandate's OWASP proposal, pricing, licence to operate and insurance pages; and customers.riskmandate.ai at v0.1.1, its home page and milestones.
